sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已上线，欢迎在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.zh: 今年春天，别只顾着打扫屋子，也给你的网络升升级吧。

sentences.zh: 他们目标明确的网络旨在提供稳定的网速，确保你在需要时随时可用。

sentences.en: And with their spring savings, you'll save up to $150 over six months on select plants.

sentences.zh: Visit aussiebroadband.com.au.

sentences.zh: 优惠截止至11月15日。

sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严肃且往往令人不安的事件。

sentences.zh: 如果您在任何时候感到需要支持，请联系当地的危机中心。

sentences.en: It was getting late on Tuesday, October 15, 1946, when 16-year-old Ruth Smock was startled by the sound of a screen door creaking behind her.
sentences.zh: 1946年10月15日星期二，天色已晚，16岁的露丝·斯莫克被身后纱门发出的吱呀声惊醒。

sentences.en: Ruth had recently moved into a rooming house in Fort Scott, Kansas, to attend a larger high school that offered more varied classes than the one in her rural Missouri hometown.
sentences.zh: 露丝最近搬进了堪萨斯州斯科特堡的一间出租屋，以便就读一所规模更大的高中，那里提供的课程比她密苏里州家乡小镇的学校更加多样化。

sentences.en: Living in the city also allowed Ruth to work part-time as a telephone operator for Southwestern Bell so she could save some money.
sentences.zh: 住在城里也让露丝有机会在西南贝尔公司兼职做接线员，这样她就能存点钱。

sentences.en: The problem was, Ruth lived alone and she wasn't expecting any visitors that evening.
sentences.zh: 问题是，露丝独自居住，而且那天晚上她并没有预期会有访客。

sentences.en: A chilling realisation quickly set in.
sentences.zh: 一种令人毛骨悚然的预感油然而生。

sentences.en: She had left the front door unlocked after returning home from the grocery store earlier.
sentences.zh: 她早些时候从杂货店回家后，忘了锁前门。

sentences.en: An unfamiliar man was now standing in her apartment.
sentences.zh: 现在，一个陌生的男人正站在她的公寓里。

sentences.en: The man was tall, appeared to be in his fifties, and was dressed in dirty bib overalls, the kind typically worn by farmers.
sentences.zh: 那男人个子很高，看起来五十多岁，穿着脏兮兮的背带裤，那是农民常穿的款式。

sentences.en: He greeted Ruth casually, saying,
sentences.zh: 他随口向露丝打了个招呼，说道：

sentences.en: Hi sis, before reaching for a wall switch and turning off the lights.
sentences.zh: “嘿，小妹。”随后伸手去按墙上的开关，关掉了灯。

sentences.en: Moving quickly, the stranger grabbed Ruth and tore at her clothes.
sentences.zh: 陌生人迅速行动，一把抓住露丝，撕扯她的衣服。

sentences.en: She fought back and managed to press her thumbs into his eyes.
sentences.zh: 她奋力反抗，设法用大拇指戳向他的眼睛。

sentences.en: This only enraged him further.
sentences.zh: 这反而让他更加狂怒。

sentences.en: I'll fix you so no one will look at you again, he threatened, shoving a rag against Ruth's face.
sentences.zh: “我要把你毁了，让你再也没脸见人。”他威胁道，并把一块抹布捂在露丝脸上。

sentences.en: Ruth felt herself growing dizzy and drowsy.
sentences.zh: 露丝感到一阵头晕目眩，昏昏欲睡。

sentences.en: Her vision blurred.
sentences.zh: 她的视线变得模糊。

sentences.en: The last thing she saw before her eyes closed completely was the man heating a flat iron on the kitchen stove.
sentences.zh: 在双眼完全闭上之前，她看到的最后一幕是那个男人正在厨房炉灶上加热一把平底熨斗。

sentences.en: By the time Ruth regained consciousness, it was 7.30 the next morning.
sentences.zh: 当露丝恢复意识时，已经是第二天早上7点半了。

sentences.en: She was sprawled on the kitchen floor, her clothes torn with cuts and scratches across her legs, neck and face.
sentences.zh: 她瘫倒在厨房地板上，衣服被撕破，双腿、脖子和脸上布满了割伤和抓痕。

sentences.en: These wounds were superficial, unlike the injuries to her thighs.
sentences.zh: 这些伤口只是皮外伤，与她大腿上的伤势不同。

sentences.en: Both of Ruth's legs bore painful first-degree burns, which had been branded onto her flesh by the flat iron.
sentences.zh: 露丝的双腿都有痛苦的一度烧伤，那是被平底熨斗烙在肉上的。

sentences.en: Ruth stayed silent on the floor until she was sure her attacker was no longer there.
sentences.zh: 露丝静静地躺在地板上，直到确定袭击者已经离开。

sentences.en: She then called her parents, who contacted the police.
sentences.zh: 随后她给父母打了电话，父母联系了警方。

sentences.en: They deduced that Ruth's attacker had soaked the rag he pressed to her face with chloroform, a sweet-smelling anaesthetic, before burning her legs while she lay unconscious.
sentences.zh: 他们推断，袭击者在露丝昏迷时，用浸过氯仿（一种气味甜美的麻醉剂）的抹布捂住她的脸，然后烫伤了她的双腿。

sentences.en: Although a physician confirmed that Ruth hadn't been raped, police were certain the crime was sexually motivated.
sentences.zh: 尽管医生证实露丝没有遭到强奸，但警方确信这起犯罪具有性动机。

sentences.en: Ruth was brought to her parents' home to recover, but later moved in with a family friend, as the thought of staying in her apartment overwhelmed her with such intense dread
sentences.zh: 露丝被送回父母家休养，但后来搬去和一位家庭朋友同住，因为一想到要待在自己的公寓里，她就感到极度的恐惧，

sentences.en: that it made her physically ill.
sentences.zh: 甚至因此引发了生理上的不适。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the violent incident made the local newspapers, as authorities worked to identify the man responsible.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这起暴力事件登上了当地报纸，当局正努力查明肇事者的身份。

sentences.en: By 1977, 31 years had passed since Ruth Smock was attacked.
sentences.zh: 到了1977年，距离露丝·斯莫克遇袭已经过去了31年。

sentences.en: 47-year-old Ruth now went by the last name Finley after marrying her high school sweetheart, 49-year-old Ed.
sentences.zh: 47岁的露丝在嫁给高中时的恋人、49岁的埃德后，改随夫姓芬利。

sentences.en: The Finleys lived in a modest, single-storey, wood-frame house on a dead-end street in Wichita, Kansas,
sentences.zh: 芬利夫妇住在堪萨斯州威奇托市一条死胡同里，那是一栋朴素的单层木结构房屋，

sentences.en: 150 miles west of Fort Scott.
sentences.zh: 距离斯科特堡以西150英里。

sentences.en: One warm June afternoon,
sentences.zh: 一个温暖的六月午后，

sentences.en: Ed was taking a break from building a patio in the backyard when he suddenly collapsed.
sentences.zh: 埃德正在后院休息，没在修露台，突然倒地不起。

sentences.en: Ruth frantically called for an ambulance and Ed was rushed to the hospital, where he regained consciousness in the emergency department.
sentences.zh: 露丝惊慌失措地叫了救护车，埃德被紧急送往医院，并在急诊室恢复了意识。

sentences.en: It was initially thought that Ed had suffered a heart attack due to the strenuous outdoor work, but doctors kept him overnight for further tests to make an official diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 起初人们认为埃德是因为剧烈的户外劳动引发了心脏病，但医生还是让他留院观察，以便进行进一步检查并做出正式诊断。

sentences.en: In the meantime, Ruth returned home alone, overwhelmed at the thought of almost losing her husband.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，露丝独自回到家中，一想到差点失去丈夫，她就感到心力交瘁。

sentences.en: She called the couple's two adult sons, as well as other family and friends, to update them on his condition.
sentences.zh: 她给夫妇俩的两个成年儿子以及其他亲友打了电话，告知了埃德的情况。

sentences.en: As the night wore on,
sentences.zh: 随着夜色渐深，

sentences.en: Ruth anxiously waited for an update from the hospital.
sentences.zh: 露丝焦急地等待着医院的消息。

sentences.en: She kept herself occupied with the television and radio, but this only made her anxiety worse.
sentences.zh: 她试图通过看电视和听广播来打发时间，但这反而加剧了她的焦虑。

sentences.en: A serial killer had been targeting women in Kansas, and the media was obsessed with reporting on the lurid details of his crimes, which involved breaking into victims' homes
sentences.zh: 当时堪萨斯州有一名连环杀手专门针对女性作案，媒体沉迷于报道其犯罪细节，这些案件涉及闯入受害者家中，

sentences.en: and committing gruesome acts of sexualised violence.
sentences.zh: 并实施令人发指的性暴力行为。

sentences.en: Being home alone at night did little to calm Ruth's nerves.
sentences.zh: 独自在家过夜，让露丝很难平静下来。

sentences.en: Every creak and crack she heard only heightened her unease.
sentences.zh: 她听到的每一声吱呀声和响动，都让她更加不安。

sentences.en: Then, at around 10.30pm, the phone rang.
sentences.zh: 这时，大约晚上10点半，电话响了。

sentences.en: When Ruth answered, a male voice on the other line asked,
sentences.zh: 露丝接起电话，电话那头传来一个男人的声音，问道：

sentences.en: Is this Ruth Smock from Fort Scott, Kansas?
sentences.zh: “你是堪萨斯州斯科特堡的露丝·斯莫克吗？”

sentences.en: The question struck her as odd.
sentences.zh: 这个问题让她觉得很奇怪。

sentences.en: Ruth had been married since 1950, and few people in her life knew her maiden name.
sentences.zh: 露丝自1950年结婚以来一直随夫姓，生活中很少有人知道她的娘家姓氏。

sentences.en: The only connection she still had to her past in Fort Scott was her ongoing employment with Southwestern Bell, though she now worked as a secretary in the company's Wichita office.
sentences.zh: 她与斯科特堡过去的唯一联系就是她仍在西南贝尔公司工作，尽管她现在是该公司威奇托办公室的一名秘书。

sentences.en: Assuming the caller was an old acquaintance,
sentences.zh: 以为打电话的是位老相识，

sentences.en: Ruth confirmed her identity.
sentences.zh: 露丝确认了自己的身份。

sentences.en: The man began asking about her past, specifically the rooming house she had lived in when she was 16.
sentences.zh: 那男人开始询问她的过去，特别是她16岁时住过的那间出租屋。

sentences.en: He then asked cryptically,
sentences.zh: 接着他意味深长地问道：

sentences.en: Do you still wear your brands?
sentences.zh: “你身上还有那些烙印吗？”

sentences.en: Feeling uneasy about his intrusive questions,
sentences.zh: 对这些侵入性的问题感到不安，

sentences.en: Ruth cautiously gave vague answers.
sentences.zh: 露丝谨慎地给出了模糊的回答。

sentences.en: This irritated the caller, who snapped,
sentences.zh: 这激怒了打电话的人，他厉声说道：

sentences.en: Look, I know all about that night.
sentences.zh: “听着，我对那天晚上的事了如指掌。”

sentences.en: Confused, Ruth replied,
sentences.zh: 露丝困惑地回答：

sentences.en: I don't know what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: “我不知道你在说什么。”

sentences.en: The man then read out what sounded like a newspaper article.
sentences.zh: 随后，那男人读出了一段听起来像是报纸文章的内容。

sentences.en: Branded on both thighs by a hot flat iron,
sentences.zh: “双腿被烧红的平底熨斗烙伤，

sentences.en: Ruth Smock, 16-year-old Fort Scott high school girl, was resting today at the home of her parents, following an attack upon her early last night
sentences.zh: 16岁的斯科特堡高中女生露丝·斯莫克，在昨晚早些时候遭遇袭击后，今天正在父母家中休养。”

sentences.en: The caller continued recounting the violent assault against Ruth from over 30 years earlier.
sentences.zh: 打电话的人继续讲述着30多年前针对露丝的那场暴力袭击。

sentences.en: While Ruth's physical wounds from that night had healed, the case had never been solved.
sentences.zh: 虽然露丝当晚留下的身体创伤早已愈合，但这起案件却从未侦破。

sentences.en: She had pushed the terrifying experience to the back of her mind, choosing to move forward with her life.
sentences.zh: 她早已将那段可怕的经历抛诸脑后，选择继续生活。

sentences.en: It wasn't something she discussed with anyone, not even her sons knew about it.
sentences.zh: 这件事她从未与任何人讨论过，连她的儿子们都不知道。

sentences.en: The caller explained that he worked for a construction company and had recently discovered a stack of old newspapers while demolishing a building in Fort Scott.
sentences.zh: 打电话的人解释说，他在一家建筑公司工作，最近在拆除斯科特堡的一栋建筑时发现了一堆旧报纸。

sentences.en: He claimed he'd found embarrassing stories about three people and planned to call them all, starting with Ruth.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己发现了三个人的尴尬往事，并计划给他们每个人都打个电话，露丝是第一个。

sentences.en: The caller told Ruth he knew where she lived and worked and threatened to leave a copy of the article about her attack where everyone in her life could see it.
sentences.zh: 那人告诉露丝，他知道她住在哪里、在哪里工作，并威胁说要把那篇关于她遇袭的文章贴在所有认识她的人都能看到的地方。

sentences.en: However, he said he'd reconsider if Ruth sent him money.
sentences.zh: 不过，他说如果露丝给他钱，他可以重新考虑。

sentences.en: At that point, Ruth hung up the phone.
sentences.zh: 听到这里，露丝挂断了电话。

sentences.en: The strange call left Ruth shaken.
sentences.zh: 这通奇怪的电话让露丝心惊肉跳。

sentences.en: Not only did it force her to confront a part of her past she had long since buried, she feared the man trying to extort her might show up at her house to confront her in person.
sentences.zh: 它不仅迫使她面对早已埋藏在心底的过去，她还担心这个试图勒索她的男人可能会找上门来当面威胁她。

sentences.en: Yet, the night passed without incident and the next morning,
sentences.zh: 然而，那一夜平安无事，第二天早上，

sentences.en: Ruth visited her husband in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 露丝去医院探望了丈夫。

sentences.en: By then, Ed's sudden collapse had been linked to an untreated injury from a car accident the previous year.
sentences.zh: 那时，埃德的突然倒地已被证实与去年一场车祸中未得到治疗的伤势有关。

sentences.en: Although Ruth was relieved to learn that Ed's heart was healthy, he remained in the hospital for several more days to recover.
sentences.zh: 尽管得知埃德心脏健康，露丝感到如释重负，但他仍需在医院多住几天以恢复身体。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Ruth nervously waited to see if the extorter would contact her again, but he didn't.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，露丝紧张地等待着勒索者是否会再次联系她，但他没有。

sentences.en: By the time Ed returned home, life for the Finleys returned to normal.
sentences.zh: 当埃德出院回家时，芬利一家的生活恢复了正常。

sentences.en: Ruth didn't tell Ed about the caller, choosing to act as though nothing had ever happened.
sentences.zh: 露丝没有告诉埃德关于那个打电话的人的事，选择表现得好像什么都没发生过一样。

sentences.en: Less than a month later, in early July,
sentences.zh: 不到一个月后，在7月初，

sentences.en: Ruth was sitting in her office at Southwestern Bell going through her Daily Mail when she came across a peculiar brown envelope.
sentences.zh: 露丝坐在西南贝尔公司的办公室里处理日常邮件时，发现了一个奇怪的棕色信封。

sentences.en: Her name was written on it in childlike handwriting, but there was no address.
sentences.zh: 上面用稚嫩的笔迹写着她的名字，但没有地址。

sentences.en: Ruth realised the envelope must have been hand-delivered as there was no way it could have made it to her through the postal system without an address printed on it.
sentences.zh: 露丝意识到这封信一定是有人亲手送来的，因为信封上没有地址，是不可能通过邮政系统寄到她手里的。

sentences.en: Inside was a yellowed newspaper clipping from the Fort Scott Tribune.
sentences.zh: 里面是一张发黄的《斯科特堡论坛报》剪报。

sentences.en: It was the same article detailing the 1946 attack on teenage Ruth that the anonymous caller had read to her weeks before.
sentences.zh: 正是几周前那个匿名电话里读给她的那篇详细报道1946年少女露丝遇袭的文章。

sentences.en: Startled, Ruth tore up the article and threw it in the trash.
sentences.zh: 露丝大吃一惊，撕碎了文章并扔进了垃圾桶。

sentences.en: Ruth's parents had raised her to be self-reliant, instilling in her the belief that emotions should be repressed and personal problems handled privately.
sentences.zh: 露丝的父母从小教育她要自立，向她灌输了一种观念：情绪应该压抑，个人问题应该私下解决。

sentences.en: As a result, Ruth chose not to tell Ed about the harassment.
sentences.zh: 因此，露丝选择不告诉埃德关于骚扰的事。

sentences.en: Over the following months, the man called the Finlay home six more times.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，那个男人又给芬利家打了六次电话。

sentences.en: As soon as Ruth recognised his voice, she hung up immediately.
sentences.zh: 露丝一听出他的声音，就立刻挂断。

sentences.en: Occasionally, Ed answered the phone, only to hear a dial tone.
sentences.zh: 偶尔埃德接起电话，却只能听到忙音。

sentences.en: He assumed they were being pranked by mischievous children.
sentences.zh: 他以为是顽皮的孩子在搞恶作剧。

sentences.en: Ruth kept the truth secret, along with the fact that her chronic headaches were getting worse.
sentences.zh: 露丝保守着这个秘密，还有她日益严重的慢性头痛。

sentences.en: She just hoped the stranger would leave her alone once he realised she wasn't willing to engage with him.
sentences.zh: 她只希望那个陌生人在意识到她不愿与他纠缠后，能放过她。

sentences.en: By August, two months had passed since the anonymous caller first contacted Ruth.
sentences.zh: 到了8月，距离匿名者第一次联系露丝已经过去了两个月。

sentences.en: She was walking the streets of downtown Wichita after finishing work for the day, waiting for Ed's shift to end so they could carpool home together.
sentences.zh: 下班后，她走在威奇托市中心的街道上，等着埃德下班，好一起拼车回家。

sentences.en: As she crossed the road at the corner of Broadway and Douglas, a male voice suddenly said,
sentences.zh: 当她走到百老汇大道和道格拉斯街的拐角处过马路时，一个男人的声音突然说道：

sentences.en: You've done a good job at work this week.
sentences.zh: “你这周工作表现不错。”

sentences.en: You can take the weekend off.
sentences.zh: “周末你可以休息一下。”

sentences.en: Ruth realised the comment was directed at her.
sentences.zh: 露丝意识到这话是对她说的。

sentences.en: He was tall, lean and appeared to be in his late 40s with brown eyes and black hair that was beginning to grey.

sentences.en: He seemed innocuous, dressed in jeans, a plaid shirt and white tennis shoes.

sentences.en: The man tried to engage Ruth in small talk, but she wasn't interested and barely acknowledged him.
sentences.zh: 那男人试图与露丝搭讪，但她毫无兴趣，几乎没理会他。

sentences.en: Undeterred, he kept pace, his questions growing more pointed.
sentences.zh: 他不死心，紧跟在后，问题也变得越来越尖锐。

sentences.en: You work for the telephone company, don't you?
sentences.zh: “你在电话公司工作，对吧？”

sentences.en: Despite Ruth's clear disinterest, he pressed on.
sentences.zh: 尽管露丝表现出明显的冷淡，他还是追问不休。

sentences.en: What do you do there?
sentences.zh: “你在那儿做什么？”

sentences.en: Are you an operator?
sentences.zh: “你是接线员吗？”

sentences.en: Ruth remained silent as the man rambled on about his love of gambling in Las Vegas, even inviting her to join him for a trip there sometime.
sentences.zh: 露丝保持沉默，而那男人则喋喋不休地谈论着他如何热爱去拉斯维加斯赌博，甚至邀请她找机会一起去旅行。

sentences.en: He then began talking about his interest in photography.

sentences.en: Annoyed,
sentences.zh: 露丝感到厌烦，

sentences.zh: 她把注意力转向附近的商店橱窗，希望那男人能知难而退，别再纠缠她。

sentences.en: When it became clear that he wasn't getting the message,
sentences.zh: 当发现他根本不领会暗示时，

sentences.en: Ruth finally said she was waiting for her husband.
sentences.zh: 露丝终于说她在等她丈夫。

sentences.en: The man then asked, Are you still married?
sentences.zh: 那男人随即问道：“你还没离婚吗？”

sentences.en: Fed up,
sentences.zh: 忍无可忍的露丝，

sentences.en: Ruth said nothing.
sentences.zh: 一言不发。

sentences.en: The man's friendly demeanour abruptly changed.
sentences.zh: 那男人友好的态度突然变了。

sentences.en: He leaned in close and said menacingly,
sentences.zh: 他凑近身子，威胁道：

sentences.en: I like your face.
sentences.zh: “我喜欢你的脸。”

sentences.en: I'll see you again.
sentences.zh: “我们还会再见面的。”

sentences.en: You can count on that.
sentences.zh: “走着瞧吧。”

sentences.en: Some people's fantasies are other people's nightmares.
sentences.zh: 有些人的幻想，却是他人的噩梦。

sentences.en: With that, he stormed off.
sentences.zh: 说完，他气势汹汹地走开了。

sentences.en: Ruth met up with Ed shortly afterward and told him about the unsettling encounter.
sentences.zh: 不久后，露丝见到了埃德，并告诉了他这次令人不安的遭遇。

sentences.en: Despite his wife's unease,
sentences.zh: 尽管妻子感到不安，

sentences.en: Ed assumed the man had been flirting with her and had reacted poorly to her rejection.
sentences.zh: 埃德却认为那男人只是在调戏她，因为被拒绝而恼羞成怒。

sentences.en: Privately,
sentences.zh: 私下里，

sentences.en: Ruth couldn't shake the nagging suspicion that he might have been the same man who'd been trying to blackmail her.
sentences.zh: 露丝却无法摆脱一个挥之不去的疑虑：他可能就是那个一直试图勒索她的人。

sentences.en: But as the months passed, the troubling calls stopped and the man in the city didn't reappear.
sentences.zh: 但随着几个月过去，那些令人不安的电话停止了，那个城里的男人也没有再出现。

sentences.en: Nearly a year later, in July 1978,
sentences.zh: 近一年后，1978年7月，

sentences.en: Ruth was walking the streets of Wichita during her lunch break when a hand suddenly shot out from an alleyway and gripped her wrist tightly.
sentences.zh: 露丝在午休时走在威奇托的街头，突然一只手从巷子里伸出来，紧紧抓住了她的手腕。

sentences.en: She turned to find the man who had accosted her

sentences.en: 11 months earlier.
sentences.zh: 11个月前。

sentences.en: Frightened, she broke free and sprinted across the street as the man yelled,
sentences.zh: 她惊恐地挣脱开，飞奔过马路，身后传来那男人的吼叫：

sentences.zh: 露丝，你这蠢货，给我滚回来跟我说话。

sentences.zh: 露丝冲进附近的一家百货商店，跑进电梯，疯狂地按下了五楼的按钮。

sentences.en: When the doors reopened, she hurried out and concealed herself among the shop displays, hoping the man wouldn't find her.
sentences.zh: 电梯门再次打开时，她匆忙跑出去，躲在商店的陈列柜中，祈祷那男人找不到她。

sentences.en: As time passed,
sentences.zh: 随着时间流逝，

sentences.en: Ruth's nerves began to settle.
sentences.zh: 露丝的情绪开始平复。

sentences.en: Eventually, she left the store and made her way to a payphone.
sentences.zh: 最终，她离开商店，走向一个公用电话亭。

sentences.en: She called her husband, telling him to come and get her right away.

sentences.en: She was well liked with no known enemies and couldn't think of a single person who would target her so maliciously.
sentences.zh: 她人缘很好，没有已知的敌人，想不出有谁会如此恶意地针对她。

sentences.zh: 露丝和埃德很惊讶，他们的案子竟然被提升到了这样一个精英部门处理。

sentences.zh: 威奇托在过去三年里一直笼罩在一种前所未有的恐惧之中。

sentences.zh: 他的罪行登上了头条，成为当地居民热议的话题，人们生活在持续的恐惧、不安和猜疑中。

sentences.en: In them, the BTK Strangler detailed his crimes and sometimes included disturbing, cryptic poeMs.
sentences.zh: 在信中，BTK勒杀手详细描述了自己的罪行，有时还附上令人不安的晦涩诗句。

sentences.en: Most were handwritten in distinct, blocky handwriting.

sentences.en: When Wichita's
sentences.zh: 当威奇托的

sentences.zh: 重案组得知露丝·

sentences.zh: 芬利的案子时，他们注意到这与

sentences.en: Since Ruth didn't appear to be in immediate, life-threatening danger, her case was relegated to the bottom of the pile of leads the division was sorting through in the
sentences.zh: 由于露丝似乎没有面临直接的生命危险，她的案子被排在了该部门正在处理的庞大调查线索堆的底部。

sentences.en: larger investigation.

sentences.en: A week later,
sentences.zh: 一周后，

sentences.en: Ruth received another letter.
sentences.zh: 露丝又收到了一封信。

sentences.en: Filled with similar writing errors to the previous one, this long-winded note demanded that Ruth leave
sentences.zh: 这封冗长的信中充满了与前一封类似的拼写错误，要求露丝把

sentences.en: The author made it clear that they knew Ruth had enlisted the help of her husband, her colleagues at
sentences.zh: 写信人明确表示，他们知道露丝寻求了丈夫、她在西南贝尔公司的同事，

sentences.zh: 甚至警方的帮助，并警告说：

sentences.zh: 别再当个蠢货把事情搞砸了。

sentences.en: I will have to see you soon if you do.

sentences.en: The letter ended with a poem.

sentences.en: Wherever you go, on water or land, you still got to pay, or I'll tell about your brand.

sentences.zh: 你和那些我鄙视的人交谈，比如警官和电话间谍。

sentences.en: Ruth took the letter to the police, and soon more arrived, each more erratic, illegible, and profane than the laSt.

sentences.zh: 露丝继续前行，突然，一辆旧的蓝绿色

sentences.zh: 1964年雪佛兰贝尔艾尔轿车停在路边，挡住了她的去路。

sentences.en: A man jumped out of the vehicle and demanded, have you got my money?
sentences.zh: 一个男人跳下车，质问道：“我的钱呢？”

sentences.en: It was the man Ruth had encountered twice before, this time wearing a denim jacket over a sweater and black framed glasses.
sentences.zh: 正是露丝之前遇到过两次的那个男人，这次他穿着一件套在毛衣外面的牛仔夹克，戴着黑框眼镜。

sentences.en: He demanded that Ruth get into his car, but she froze in fear, unable to move or speak.
sentences.zh: 他强迫露丝上车，但她吓得僵在原地，动弹不得，也说不出话来。

sentences.en: The man kicked Ruth hard in the shin, causing her to double over in pain.
sentences.zh: 那男人狠狠踢了露丝的小腿，疼得她蜷缩起来。

sentences.en: He then forced her into the back seat of the Bel Air and climbed in beside her.
sentences.zh: 随后他强行把她塞进贝尔艾尔轿车的后座，并挤在她身边坐下。

sentences.en: A second man sat behind the wheel.
sentences.zh: 驾驶座上坐着第二个男人。

sentences.en: He hit the accelerator and the car shot forward.
sentences.zh: 他猛踩油门，车子向前冲去。

sentences.en: The car had seen better days.
sentences.zh: 这辆车已经破旧不堪了。

sentences.en: The tattered back seat was cluttered with the junk that
sentences.zh: 破烂的后座上堆满了露丝认为是从农场里弄来的垃圾。

sentences.en: Ruth assumed had come from a farm.
sentences.zh: 汽油桶、混凝土块、铁链和破布。

sentences.en: Gas cans, chunks of concrete, chains and rags.
sentences.zh: 左后窗用塑料胶带封着，副驾驶车门凹陷，仪表盘用白色胶带修补过。

sentences.en: The left rear window was taped with plastic, the passenger door was bashed in, and the dashboard was patched with white tape.
sentences.zh: 车子行驶时，两个男人不停地交谈，轮流喝着一瓶用棕色纸包裹的酒。

sentences.en: As they drove along, the two men talked incessantly, taking long swigs from a bottle wrapped in brown paper that they passed between them.
sentences.zh: 露丝努力捕捉他们谈话的内容。

sentences.en: Ruth strained to catch as much of their conversation as she could.
sentences.zh: 她推断出司机叫巴迪，但没听清那个抓住她的男人的名字。

sentences.en: She deduced that the driver was called Buddy, but she didn't catch the name of the man who'd grabbed her.
sentences.zh: 那男人很快又把注意力转向露丝，要求她交出钱包。

sentences.en: The man soon turned his attention back to Ruth and demanded she give him her purse.
sentences.zh: 露丝交出了钱包，男人翻找了一番，然后兴高采烈地宣布：“我们发财了。”

sentences.en: Ruth handed it over, and the man rummaged through it before announcing gleefully, we've struck it rich.
sentences.zh: 但当他发现一张负责她案件的侦探的名片时，心情立刻变坏了。

sentences.en: But his mood soured when he found a business card for one of the detectives working on her case.
sentences.zh: 他把名片给巴迪看，两人随即爆发出一连串愤怒的咒骂。

sentences.en: He showed it to Buddy, and the two men exchanged a volley of angry profanities.
sentences.zh: 毫无预兆地，那男人用一块混凝土块猛击露丝的脸侧，咆哮道：“你这该死的蠢货。”

sentences.en: Without warning, the man struck Ruth in the side of the face with a chunk of concrete, barking, you damn stupid bitch.
sentences.zh: 露丝瘫坐在后座，神志恍惚，一言不发，而巴迪则在城里漫无目的地开车。

sentences.en: Ruth sat back, dazed and silent, while Buddy drove aimlessly through the city.
sentences.zh: 她偶尔瞥见绑架者挥舞着一把弹簧刀。

sentences.en: She occasionally caught glimpses of her captor wielding a switchblade.
sentences.zh: 她脑海中闪过逃跑的念头，但身边的车门把手坏了，她不确定如果从飞驰的车上跳下去能否活命。

sentences.en: Thoughts of escape crossed her mind, but the door handle next to her was broken, and she wasn't sure she'd survive if she jumped from the speeding car.
sentences.zh: 她的钱包被还了回来，里面有一罐防狼喷雾，但她想不出如何在不被男人发现的情况下拿出来。

sentences.en: Her purse had been returned, and inside it was a can of mace, but she couldn't figure out how to retrieve it without the man noticing.
sentences.zh: 有一次，露丝无意中听到

sentences.zh: 双湖购物中心。

sentences.en: The other man muttered, we'll get rid of her, but not here.
sentences.zh: 另一个人嘟囔着说，我们会除掉她，但不是在这里。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, back at
sentences.zh: 与此同时，回到

sentences.zh: 西南贝尔公司，露丝的同事们发现她午休后一直没回来。

sentences.en: Calls were made to Ed Finley and then to the police, but without anyone knowing Ruth's exact location, her situation grew dire.
sentences.zh: 他们给埃德·芬利打了电话，随后又报了警，但由于没人知道露丝的具体位置，她的处境变得岌岌可危。

sentences.en: Hours passed and the sun set as
sentences.zh: 几个小时过去了，太阳落山了，

sentences.en: Ruth's captors continued driving her around town.
sentences.zh: 绑架露丝的人继续开车带着她在城里转悠。

sentences.en: All the while, Ruth despaired over what might be in store for her.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，露丝一直为自己可能面临的命运感到绝望。

sentences.en: At one point, the man in the back seat sneered,
sentences.zh: 有一次，后座的男人冷笑着说：

sentences.zh: 你喜欢喝啤酒吗？

sentences.zh: 我们去买点啤酒，开个派对。

sentences.zh: 露丝终于鼓起勇气开口，告诉那个男人她需要上厕所。

sentences.en: To prevent Ruth from fleeing, the men ordered that she hand over her coat and shoes.
sentences.zh: 为了防止露丝逃跑，这些人命令她交出外套和鞋子。

sentences.en: Ruth's captor got out of the car and dragged her by the arm into the park, remarking,
sentences.zh: 绑架露丝的人下了车，拽着她的胳膊把她拖进公园，并说道：

sentences.en: I'll watch you and you'll watch me.
sentences.zh: 我看着你，你看着我。

sentences.en: Doesn't that sound like fun?
sentences.zh: 听起来是不是很有趣？

sentences.en: As they walked, Ruth discreetly tucked her hand into her purse, gripping the can of mace.
sentences.zh: 走着走着，露丝悄悄把手伸进钱包，紧紧握住了防狼喷雾。

sentences.en: When they reached a small lake, the man released his hold on Ruth so that he could urinate firSt.
sentences.zh: 当他们走到一个小湖边时，男人松开了露丝，以便自己先小便。

sentences.en: As he unzipped his pants, Ruth grabbed the mace and sprayed it at him.
sentences.zh: 就在他拉开裤子拉链时，露丝抓起喷雾朝他喷去。

sentences.en: The man collapsed in a coughing fit, giving Ruth the opportunity to flee.
sentences.zh: 男人倒在地上剧烈咳嗽，这给了露丝逃跑的机会。

sentences.en: Barefoot, she darted across the muddy ground, slid down an embankment and crouched behind a large bush.
sentences.zh: 她光着脚在泥泞的地上飞奔，滑下一道堤岸，躲进了一丛大灌木后面。

sentences.en: She heard the man yell,
sentences.zh: 她听到那个男人大喊：

sentences.en: You'll freeze if we leave you here.
sentences.zh: 如果我们把你留在这，你会冻死的。

sentences.en: Come and get your shoes and your coat and we won't bother you anymore.
sentences.zh: 过来拿回你的鞋子和外套，我们就不会再打扰你了。

sentences.en: Ruth remained silent, her body shivering and her feet numb from the cold.
sentences.zh: 露丝保持沉默，身体颤抖，双脚因寒冷而麻木。

sentences.en: She stayed hidden in the dark until the man stopped shouting and she sensed he had gone.
sentences.zh: 她躲在黑暗中，直到那个男人停止叫喊，她感觉到他已经离开了。

sentences.en: Ruth crept out from behind the bush and climbed back up the small rise, scanning the area for the Bel Air.
sentences.zh: 露丝从灌木丛后爬出来，爬回小坡上，扫视着周围寻找那辆别克车。

sentences.en: It was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 车子不见踪影。

sentences.en: She quickly left the park and ran to a liquor store across the road, yelling,
sentences.zh: 她迅速离开公园，跑向马路对面的一家酒水店，大喊道：

sentences.en: Someone's after me.
sentences.zh: 有人在追我。

sentences.en: The store clerk immediately called the police, who arrived to collect Ruth and take her to the station, where she was reunited with her husband dead.
sentences.zh: 店员立即报了警，警察赶到后接走了露丝，并将她带到警局，在那里她与丈夫重逢了。

sentences.en: Ruth learned that her abductors had stolen her $315 paycheck, a $100 US savings bond and a few other random items, including some stationery.
sentences.zh: 露丝得知绑匪偷走了她315美元的工资支票、一张100美元的美国储蓄债券以及其他一些杂物，包括一些信纸。

sentences.en: Police examined the park where Ruth had been taken.
sentences.zh: 警方检查了露丝被带去的公园。

sentences.en: They found her shoes and coat near the embankment she had fled down, along with footprints showing her escape route.
sentences.zh: 他们在她逃跑的堤岸附近发现了她的鞋子和外套，还有显示她逃跑路线的脚印。

sentences.en: However, the assailants had left behind no other clues.
sentences.zh: 然而，袭击者没有留下任何其他线索。

sentences.en: A localised check on every model of
sentences.zh: 警方对每一款符合露丝描述的

sentences.en: Chevrolet that matched Ruth's description was conducted, with each vehicle tracked down and ruled out.
sentences.zh: 雪佛兰车型进行了排查，追踪并排除了每一辆车。

sentences.en: Detectives also revisited the
sentences.zh: 侦探们还重新调查了

sentences.en: 1946 attack on Ruth, travelling to
sentences.zh: 1946年针对露丝的袭击事件，前往

sentences.zh: 斯科特堡寻找利兹。

sentences.en: In the meantime, Ruth continued to receive long, rambling letters from her tormentor.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，露丝不断收到折磨她的人寄来的冗长、语无伦次的信件。

sentences.en: In one, he enclosed the stationery that was stolen from her purse, confirming that the letter writer and the abductor were one and the same.
sentences.zh: 在其中一封信里，他附上了从她钱包里偷走的信纸，证实了写信人和绑架者是同一个人。

sentences.en: In another letter, he accused Ruth of deliberately confusing him.
sentences.zh: 在另一封信中，他指责露丝故意让他困惑。

sentences.en: He claimed to have mistaken Ruth's sister,
sentences.zh: 他声称把露丝的妹妹

sentences.en: Jean, for her, a common mistake as the two sisters looked alike.
sentences.zh: 简误认成了她，因为姐妹俩长得很像，这是一种常见的误认。

sentences.en: Jean was rattled when she learned that the man had been mistakenly stalking her as well.
sentences.zh: 当简得知那个男人也一直在误认并跟踪她时，她感到非常不安。

sentences.en: Ruth tried to reassure her, saying, He doesn't want you.
sentences.zh: 露丝试图安慰她，说：他想要的不是你。

sentences.en: He wants me.
sentences.zh: 他想要的是我。

sentences.en: Ruth was in a state of despair.
sentences.zh: 露丝陷入了绝望之中。

sentences.en: Her headaches were now a daily occurrence and accompanied by crippling abdominal pain.
sentences.zh: 她的头痛现在每天都会发作，并伴有剧烈的腹痛。

sentences.en: Things worsened when the man began leaving letters about Ruth throughout Wichita and writing to the local papers.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，那个男人开始在威奇托各处留下关于露丝的信件，并写信给当地报纸。

sentences.en: This thrust Ruth into the spotlight and made the otherwise private and reserved woman the subject of local gossip.
sentences.zh: 这把露丝推向了聚光灯下，让原本私密且内向的她成了当地人的谈资。

sentences.en: The man claimed he was a poet, though people didn't know it.
sentences.zh: 那个男人自称是诗人，尽管人们并不知情。

sentences.en: This, along with his habit for penning violent and sexual rhymes, led to him being referred to as the poet.
sentences.zh: 这一点，加上他喜欢写暴力和色情韵文的习惯，导致他被称为“诗人”。

sentences.en: Sometimes his poems were long and elaborate, other times they were short and simple, resembling children's rhymes.
sentences.zh: 有时他的诗写得很长且复杂，有时又短小简单，像儿歌一样。

sentences.en: In his writings, he called Ruth a whore, an accusation that seemed completely unfounded.
sentences.zh: 在文章中，他称露丝为妓女，这种指控似乎完全毫无根据。

sentences.en: Detectives spoke at length with Ruth and concluded that she was a kind, upstanding, church-going woman who was fiercely devoted to her husband.
sentences.zh: 侦探们与露丝进行了深入交谈，结论是她是一位善良、正直、经常去教堂的女性，对丈夫忠贞不渝。

sentences.en: This wasn't a case of a married woman living a secret double life.
sentences.zh: 这并非已婚女性过着秘密双重生活的情况。

sentences.en: They could tell Ruth's fear was genuine and that she truly had no idea who the poet was or why she was being targeted.
sentences.zh: 他们能看出露丝的恐惧是真实的，她确实不知道“诗人”是谁，也不知道为什么自己会成为目标。

sentences.en: Despite this, the poet continued to imply a personal connection between them, writing,
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，“诗人”继续暗示他们之间存在某种个人联系，写道：

sentences.en: You know in your fucked up mind you are going to die.
sentences.zh: 你那扭曲的心里清楚，你终将一死。

sentences.en: You don't know when, but you do know why.
sentences.zh: 你不知道是什么时候，但你知道原因。

sentences.en: In a letter to local newspaper, The Eagle Beacon, the poet gloated about his anonymity.
sentences.zh: 在给当地报纸《鹰报》的一封信中，“诗人”对自己的匿名身份沾沾自喜。

sentences.en: Good or evil, my secret shall not be known.
sentences.zh: 无论善恶，我的秘密都不会被知晓。

sentences.en: I unnoticed, go my way.
sentences.zh: 我悄无声息，走我自己的路。

sentences.en: I may just prosper for one day.
sentences.zh: 或许有一天，我会飞黄腾达。

sentences.en: He also scolded the publication for mentioning both him and the BTK Strangler in the same article, warning them not to confuse the executioners again.
sentences.zh: 他还斥责该报纸在同一篇文章中同时提到他和“BTK杀手”，警告他们不要再搞混这些行刑者。

sentences.en: I am not dangerous, he claimed.
sentences.zh: 我并不危险，他声称。

sentences.en: Just to those who are too dumb to do what they are told.
sentences.zh: 只是对那些太蠢而不听话的人来说很危险。

sentences.en: He even sent a letter to a detective overseeing Ruth's case, accusing him of protecting a, quote, whore from death.
sentences.zh: 他甚至给负责露丝案件的侦探写了一封信，指责他保护了一个“妓女”免于死亡。

sentences.en: In an effort to generate more leads, the detective appeared on a live radio talk show and described Ruth's ordeal in detail.
sentences.zh: 为了获得更多线索，侦探参加了一个现场广播脱口秀节目，详细描述了露丝的遭遇。

sentences.en: During the broadcast,
sentences.zh: 在广播期间，

sentences.en: Ruth listened closely to each incoming call to the radio station, but none of the callers sounded like her stalker.
sentences.zh: 露丝仔细聆听了每一个打进电台的电话，但没有一个听起来像她的跟踪者。

sentences.en: Each night, while Ruth slept,
sentences.zh: 每天晚上，当露丝睡觉时，

sentences.en: Ed kept watch over the house, hiding in the bushes armed with a 12-gauge shotgun and a revolver.
sentences.zh: 埃德都会守在房子周围，躲在灌木丛中，手持一把12口径的霰弹枪和一把左轮手枪。

sentences.en: The Finleys continued to receive letters sporadically into 1979, sometimes as many as two at a time.
sentences.zh: 芬利夫妇在1979年期间仍断断续续地收到信件，有时一次收到两封。

sentences.en: They tried to maintain a sense of normalcy in their lives, even preparing for their annual trip to a ranch resort in western Colorado.
sentences.zh: 他们试图维持生活的正常感，甚至准备去科罗拉多州西部的一个牧场度假村进行年度旅行。

sentences.en: On Monday, August 13, while Ruth was packing for the trip, she realised she needed a new pair of jeans.
sentences.zh: 8月13日星期一，当露丝正在收拾行李准备旅行时，她意识到自己需要一条新牛仔裤。

sentences.en: Putting her fears aside, she drove to Town East Mall and bought what she needed.
sentences.zh: 抛开恐惧，她开车去了东城购物中心买了需要的东西。

sentences.en: By the time she finished shopping, it was late and the sun was setting.
sentences.zh: 当她购物结束时，天色已晚，太阳正在落山。

sentences.en: As she walked back to her car,
sentences.zh: 当她走回车边时，

sentences.en: Ruth was struck by the unsettling sensation that someone was following her.
sentences.zh: 露丝产生了一种不安的感觉，好像有人在跟踪她。

sentences.en: However, each time she turned around, the parking lot seemed deserted, with no one in sight.
sentences.zh: 然而，每次她回头看时，停车场似乎都很空旷，一个人影也没有。

sentences.en: Nervous, Ruth hurried toward her car when a familiar voice called out,
sentences.zh: 紧张的露丝快步走向车子，这时一个熟悉的声音喊道：

sentences.en: Hey Ruth, I didn't know you were going to make this so easy.
sentences.zh: 嘿，露丝，我没想到你会这么容易得手。

sentences.en: Ruth broke into a sprint.
sentences.zh: 露丝开始飞奔。

sentences.en: She reached her car and jammed a key into the door, but it wouldn't open.
sentences.zh: 她到达车边，把钥匙插进车门，但打不开。

sentences.en: She had used the wrong key.
sentences.zh: 她用错钥匙了。

sentences.en: A gloved hand appeared from behind her and grabbed her wriSt.
sentences.zh: 一只戴着手套的手从她身后伸出来，抓住了她的手腕。

sentences.en: It was the same man who had abducted her the year before.
sentences.zh: 正是去年绑架她的那个男人。

sentences.en: He pushed Ruth's head against the car and ordered her to get in, tossing a brown paper shopping bag through the partially open rear window.
sentences.zh: 他把露丝的头按在车上，命令她进去，并从半开的后窗扔进一个棕色纸购物袋。

sentences.en: We'll go to a nice little place where it says, keep out, he said.
sentences.zh: 我们要去一个写着“禁止入内”的好地方，他说。

sentences.en: Ruth pushed the man away and tried to run, but within seconds, he pulled an eight-inch boning knife from his pocket and stabbed her twice in the back and once in the side.
sentences.zh: 露丝推开男人试图逃跑，但几秒钟内，他从口袋里掏出一把八英寸长的剔骨刀，刺了她后背两刀，侧面一刀。

sentences.en: Fueled by adrenaline and desperation,
sentences.zh: 在肾上腺素和绝望的驱使下，

sentences.en: Ruth scrambled into her car.
sentences.zh: 露丝挣扎着钻进车里。

sentences.en: The man reached through the open driver's side window, but she managed to wind it up quickly, trapping his hand for a moment before he withdrew.
sentences.zh: 男人从打开的驾驶座车窗伸手进来，但她迅速摇上车窗，夹住了他的手，片刻后他才缩了回去。

sentences.en: Ruth started the engine and sped off, the boning knife still lodged in her side.
sentences.zh: 露丝发动引擎疾驰而去，剔骨刀还插在她的侧面。

sentences.en: Blood soaked into the car seat as she fought back tears, her body racked with pain.
sentences.zh: 血浸透了车座，她强忍泪水，身体痛苦不堪。

sentences.en: She pulled into a gas station and called the police from a payphone.
sentences.zh: 她把车开进一家加油站，用公用电话报了警。

sentences.en: They urged her to stay put, but terrified that the man might be following her,
sentences.zh: 警察劝她待在原地，但她害怕那个男人可能在跟踪她，

sentences.en: Ruth got back into her car and drove home.
sentences.zh: 露丝又回到车里开车回家。

sentences.en: By the time she arrived, her vision blurred and she was on the verge of passing out.
sentences.zh: 当她到达时，视线模糊，几乎要昏厥过去。

sentences.en: Ed rushed to Ruth the moment she pulled up.
sentences.zh: 埃德在露丝停车的瞬间冲了过去。

sentences.en: He gently moved her into the passenger seat and drove to the hospital, while Ruth drifted in and out of consciousness.
sentences.zh: 他轻轻地把她移到副驾驶座上，开车送往医院，而露丝在意识模糊中挣扎。

sentences.en: The doctors concluded that Ruth had been incredibly lucky.
sentences.zh: 医生断定露丝非常幸运。

sentences.en: If the knife had been a fraction of an inch deeper, her kidney would have been punctured and she would have died.
sentences.zh: 如果刀再深几分之一英寸，她的肾脏就会被刺穿，她就会丧命。

sentences.en: The paper bag her attacker threw into her back seat painted a harrowing image of his intentions.
sentences.zh: 袭击者扔进她后座的纸袋描绘了他意图的可怕画面。

sentences.en: It contained clothesline rope, white tape, a red bandana, and a half-empty bottle of wine.
sentences.zh: 里面装着晾衣绳、白胶带、一条红头巾和半瓶酒。

sentences.en: After a successful surgery and nine days of recovery under 24-hour police protection,
sentences.zh: 在成功手术并接受了九天24小时警方保护的康复治疗后，

sentences.en: Ruth was cleared to return home.
sentences.zh: 露丝获准回家。

sentences.en: Before she arrived, the police thoroughly examined every inch of the Finleys' house and deemed it safe.
sentences.zh: 在她到达之前，警方彻底检查了芬利家房子的每一个角落，认为它是安全的。

sentences.en: Not long after Ruth was released from hospital, a detective arrived at the Finleys' door, visibly shaken.
sentences.zh: 露丝出院后不久，一名侦探来到芬利家门口，神情明显不安。

sentences.en: He explained that he'd received a call from the hospital where Ruth had been treated.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，他接到了露丝接受治疗的医院打来的电话。

sentences.en: A man had shown up, asking specifically for her.
sentences.zh: 有个男人出现过，专门打听她。

sentences.en: A nurse believed he might have been Ruth's assailant, but by the time authorities arrived, he'd already left.
sentences.zh: 一名护士认为他可能是露丝的袭击者，但当当局赶到时，他已经离开了。

sentences.en: Fearing for her safety, police quietly moved Ruth to a safe location.
sentences.zh: 出于对她安全的担忧，警方悄悄将露丝转移到了一个安全地点。

sentences.en: In the days that followed, they kept the Finleys' house under constant surveillance, but the man didn't appear.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几天里，他们对芬利家进行了持续监视，但那个男人没有出现。

sentences.en: News of Ruth's stabbing made headlines across Wichita, with composite sketches of the offender widely circulated and a $3,000 reward offered for information leading to his capture.
sentences.zh: 露丝被刺的消息登上了威奇托各地的头条，罪犯的合成素描被广泛传播，并悬赏3000美元征集抓捕线索。

sentences.en: At one point, the poet case generated more tips than the higher-profile
sentences.zh: 有段时间，“诗人”案产生的线索比备受关注的

sentences.en: BTK Strangler investigation.
sentences.zh: “BTK杀手”调查还要多。

sentences.en: Detectives began looking into individuals with criminal backgrounds that matched the poet's behaviour.
sentences.zh: 侦探们开始调查那些犯罪背景与“诗人”行为相符的人。

sentences.en: They showed Ruth photos of potential suspects, but she ruled each of them out.
sentences.zh: 他们给露丝看了潜在嫌疑人的照片，但她一一排除了。

sentences.en: At one stage, the investigation turned toward the Finleys themselves.
sentences.zh: 有段时间，调查转向了芬利夫妇自己。

sentences.en: Ed was questioned thoroughly, but he assured the police that he would never hurt his wife.
sentences.zh: 埃德接受了彻底盘问，但他向警方保证，他绝不会伤害自己的妻子。

sentences.en: The FBI compared his handwriting with that of the poet and determined it wasn't a match.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局将他的笔迹与“诗人”的笔迹进行了比对，确定不匹配。

sentences.en: Additionally, a medical report ruled out the possibility that Ruth could have inflicted the stab wounds to herself at such an angle and with such force.
sentences.zh: 此外，一份医疗报告排除了露丝以那种角度和力度自残的可能性。

sentences.en: An independent doctor reached the same conclusion.
sentences.zh: 一位独立医生也得出了同样的结论。

sentences.en: For a while,
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，

sentences.en: Ruth was closely monitored by eight plainclothes police officers as she went about her daily activities outside the home.
sentences.zh: 露丝在户外进行日常活动时，受到八名便衣警察的严密监视。

sentences.en: On some occasions, a detective hid out of sight in the back of her car, armed with a shotgun.
sentences.zh: 有时，一名侦探会带着霰弹枪躲在她的车后座里。

sentences.en: Others patrolled the city in unmarked police cars or went undercover, spending weeks lurking through Wichita, keeping an eye out for the poet.
sentences.zh: 其他人则开着无标志的警车在城里巡逻，或者进行卧底，在威奇托潜伏数周，留意“诗人”的踪迹。

sentences.en: But, he managed to elude them.
sentences.zh: 但是，他还是设法躲过了他们。

sentences.en: In an attempt to lure him out,
sentences.zh: 为了引诱他出来，

sentences.en: Ed Finley posted a coded message in the classified section of the Eagle Beacon.
sentences.zh: 埃德·芬利在《鹰报》的分类广告栏发布了一条加密信息。

sentences.en: The ad read,
sentences.zh: 广告写道：

sentences.en: Poet, tell me what I owe you.
sentences.zh: 诗人，告诉我我欠你什么。

sentences.en: It was signed with Ruth's initials,
sentences.zh: 署名是露丝的首字母缩写，

sentences.en: RSF.
sentences.zh: RSF。

sentences.en: To Ed's surprise, the poet seemingly responded,
sentences.zh: 令埃德惊讶的是，“诗人”似乎做出了回应，

sentences.en: The cryptic nature of the message left Ed and the police baffled.
sentences.zh: 信息的神秘性让埃德和警方感到困惑。

sentences.en: The poet continued to communicate to them through the newspaper, though his messages offered no new or helpful information.
sentences.zh: “诗人”继续通过报纸与他们交流，尽管他的信息没有提供任何新的或有用的线索。

sentences.en: As time wore on,
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，

sentences.en: Ruth's fear gave way to profound depression.
sentences.zh: 露丝的恐惧转变为深度的抑郁。

sentences.en: She felt utterly helpless, resigned to the belief that the poet would eventually get her.
sentences.zh: 她感到彻底无助，屈服于“诗人”最终会抓住她的信念。

sentences.en: The sense of dread grew when the Finleys found another letter from the poet wedged in the slats of their front porch, marking the first time he'd personally delivered
sentences.zh: 当芬利夫妇发现另一封“诗人”的信塞在他们前廊的板条里时，这种恐惧感加剧了，这是他第一次亲自把

sentences.en: a letter to their home.
sentences.zh: 信送到他们家。

sentences.en: At night, they began hearing strange noises coming from their garage, leading them to believe someone was lurking there.
sentences.zh: 晚上，他们开始听到车库里传来奇怪的声音，这让他们认为有人潜伏在那里。

sentences.en: Then, on Christmas Eve of 1979, their phone lines were cut.
sentences.zh: 随后，在1979年的平安夜，他们的电话线被切断了。

sentences.en: Ruth agreed to undergo hypnosis in an attempt to uncover any suppressed memories of her abduction and stabbing.
sentences.zh: 露丝同意接受催眠，试图挖掘出她被绑架和刺伤时被压抑的记忆。

sentences.en: In the first session, she quickly slipped into a trance and recounted the events in vivid detail, even shouting, I want out of the car, as she relived the abduction.
sentences.zh: 在第一次治疗中，她很快进入了恍惚状态，并生动地重述了当时的事件，甚至在重温绑架过程时大喊：“我要下车”。

sentences.en: However, no new insights emerged from this first session.
sentences.zh: 然而，这次治疗并没有带来任何新的见解。

sentences.en: During her second session a few days later,
sentences.zh: 几天后的第二次治疗期间，

sentences.en: Ruth recalled that her attacker had mentioned something about a bridge over a river near the airfield east of town.
sentences.zh: 露丝回忆起袭击者曾提到过城东机场附近的一座河流桥梁。

sentences.en: Detectives followed this fresh lead and eventually located a bridge matching Ruth's description, but they couldn't determine its relevance to the case.
sentences.zh: 侦探们顺着这条新线索，最终找到了符合露丝描述的桥梁，但无法确定它与案件的关联。

sentences.en: Later, the poet sent the police written instructions to meet him at the bridge, but he never showed up.
sentences.zh: 后来，这位“诗人”给警方写信，指示他们在桥上见面，但他从未露面。

sentences.en: In another letter, he referred to a box full of things the police would love to find, allegedly near a rocky stream.
sentences.zh: 在另一封信中，他提到了一个装满警方很想找到的东西的盒子，据称就在一条多石的溪流附近。

sentences.en: Officers spent eight hours digging along a dry riverbed near the airfield, but found nothing.
sentences.zh: 警官们在机场附近的一条干涸河床上挖掘了八个小时，却一无所获。

sentences.en: The psychologist who had hypnotised
sentences.zh: 为露丝进行催眠的心理学家

sentences.en: Ruth suggested that the poet might have received psychological treatment or spent time in a state institution.
sentences.zh: 建议说，这位“诗人”可能接受过心理治疗，或者曾在国家机构待过。

sentences.en: He described the attacker as withdrawn, seclusive, secretive, and suspicious.
sentences.zh: 他将袭击者描述为孤僻、隐居、神秘且多疑的人。

sentences.en: After reviewing the poet's letters, the psychologist confirmed that the author was highly intelligent.
sentences.zh: 在审阅了“诗人”的信件后，心理学家确认作者非常聪明。

sentences.en: A prominent psycholinguist created a psychological profile of the poet, describing him as severely psychotic, schizophrenic, pathologically paranoid, and a loner with a deep
sentences.zh: 一位著名的心理语言学家为“诗人”建立了心理侧写，将其描述为严重的精神病患者、精神分裂症患者、病态偏执狂，以及一个有着深重

sentences.en: sense of persecution.
sentences.zh: 受迫害感的独行侠。

sentences.en: Although he acknowledged that the poet and the BTK strangler shared a highly similar style and pathology, he didn't believe they were the same person.
sentences.zh: 尽管他承认“诗人”和BTK连环杀手的风格与病理特征高度相似，但他不认为他们是同一个人。

sentences.en: While the investigation kept stalling, the letters to Ruth continued to arrive.
sentences.zh: 虽然调查陷入停滞，但寄给露丝的信件却源源不断。

sentences.en: One read,
sentences.zh: 其中一封写道：

sentences.en: You'll not go directly to your tomb.
sentences.zh: 你不会直接走向坟墓。

sentences.en: Your mind must give thought.
sentences.zh: 你的大脑必须思考。

sentences.en: There will be gloom.
sentences.zh: 阴霾终将笼罩。

sentences.en: Your face no more will anyone meet, at home, day or night, or in the street.
sentences.zh: 无论在家中、街上，还是昼夜，再无人能见你的容颜。

sentences.en: Your mind is beaten, dark, forevermore hid.
sentences.zh: 你的心智已被击碎、陷入黑暗，永远被掩埋。

sentences.en: All because of what you did.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是因为你的所作所为。

sentences.en: This game is fun to plan and plot, but can you stop me?
sentences.zh: 这场游戏策划起来很有趣，但你能阻止我吗？

sentences.en: No, you cannot.
sentences.zh: 不，你不能。

sentences.en: The poet remained active into 1980 and a new officer in command was assigned to oversee the case.
sentences.zh: “诗人”在1980年依然活跃，一位新的指挥官被指派负责监督此案。

sentences.en: The poet mocked him in a letter, writing,
sentences.zh: “诗人”在信中嘲弄了他，写道：

sentences.en: There once was a captain who had an arsehole for a heart.
sentences.zh: 曾有一位队长，心如粪土。

sentences.en: The Finley's house gate was rigged with an alarm and the police hid a surveillance camera in a birdhouse in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 芬利家的门上安装了警报器，警方还在后院的鸟屋里隐藏了一个监控摄像头。

sentences.en: The wires snaked through a garden hose leading to a monitor on the Finley's dining table producing a live feed.
sentences.zh: 电线穿过花园软管，连接到芬利家餐桌上的监视器，进行实时直播。

sentences.en: Police officers worked round the clock to monitor the feed
sentences.zh: 警官们全天候轮班监控画面，

sentences.en: 24-7, but eventually, the poet managed to inconspicuously cut the garden hose.
sentences.zh: 24小时不间断，但最终，“诗人”还是悄无声息地切断了花园软管。

sentences.en: In January,
sentences.zh: 一月份，

sentences.en: Ruth received a call at work.
sentences.zh: 露丝在工作中接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: I have a surprise for you in the lobby, the poet said, before abruptly hanging up.
sentences.zh: “我在大厅里给你准备了一个惊喜，”诗人说完，便突然挂断了电话。

sentences.en: Ruth immediately contacted the police who arrived to find a 12-inch butcher knife wrapped in a red bandana in the lobby's phone booth.
sentences.zh: 露丝立即联系了警方，他们赶到后在大厅的电话亭里发现了一把用红色头巾包裹的12英寸屠刀。

sentences.en: Two witnesses reported seeing a man matching the poet's description near the booth, but he had left by the time authorities arrived.
sentences.zh: 两名目击者报告说在电话亭附近看到一名符合“诗人”描述的男子，但当局赶到时他已经离开了。

sentences.en: Two days later,
sentences.zh: 两天后，

sentences.en: Ruth received another chilling poem.
sentences.zh: 露丝又收到了一首令人毛骨悚然的诗。

sentences.en: Shut your eyes and think of the 12-inch blade.
sentences.zh: 闭上眼，想想那12英寸的刀刃。

sentences.en: Will you remember the hole it made?
sentences.zh: 你还记得它留下的伤口吗？

sentences.en: Dream of me and obey my commands.
sentences.zh: 梦见我，服从我的命令。

sentences.en: Think of me with a knife in my hands.
sentences.zh: 想象我手持利刃的样子。

sentences.en: In February, the poet sent Ruth a strip of red bandana tied with twine accompanied by a letter that read,
sentences.zh: 二月份，“诗人”给露丝寄来了一块用麻绳捆绑的红色头巾碎片，并附上一封信，写道：

sentences.en: Here's to you, tender Valentine, red with blood and tied with twine.
sentences.zh: 送给你，温柔的情人，染血的红布，系上麻绳。

sentences.en: Nothing too much for a Valentine.
sentences.zh: 给情人什么都不嫌多。

sentences.en: Gone from here by whim of mind.
sentences.zh: 随心所欲，离此而去。

sentences.en: By this point, the Finley's entire life was consumed by the poet.
sentences.zh: 此时，芬利夫妇的整个生活都被“诗人”占据了。

sentences.en: Much of their day was spent examining their home for letters, attempting to decode his latest ramblings, speaking with the police and worrying about his next move.
sentences.zh: 他们大部分时间都在家里检查是否有信件，试图破译他最新的胡言乱语，与警方交谈，并担心他的下一步行动。

sentences.en: They barely slept, with Ed reaching for his gun at every creek in the night.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎无法入睡，埃德在夜里听到任何响动都会去拿枪。

sentences.en: The poet went to great lengths to upend every facet of Ruth's life.
sentences.zh: “诗人”不遗余力地搅乱露丝生活的方方面面。

sentences.en: He sent a letter to a local florist instructing them to deliver a single black flower to her.
sentences.zh: 他写信给当地一家花店，指示他们送一朵黑色的花给她。

sentences.en: He wrote to Ruth's bank demanding the transfer of all her funds.
sentences.zh: 他写信给露丝的银行，要求转走她所有的资金。

sentences.en: He contacted the Kansas Department of Motor Vehicles, falsely claiming that Ruth had been driving recklessly and urging them to revoke her driver's licence.
sentences.zh: 他联系了堪萨斯州车管所，谎称露丝驾驶鲁莽，敦促他们吊销她的驾照。

sentences.en: Utility providers received letters requesting that the Finley household's gas and electricity be shut off.
sentences.zh: 公用事业供应商收到了要求切断芬利家天然气和电力的信件。

sentences.en: A locksmith was asked to create a new set of keys for their home while a construction company was instructed to dump a mound of dirt in their driveway.
sentences.zh: 他要求锁匠为他们家配一套新钥匙，并指示一家建筑公司在他们的车道上倾倒一堆泥土。

sentences.en: A towing company was told to collect the Finley's vehicles and the health department was falsely informed that Ruth was spreading venereal diseases.
sentences.zh: 一家拖车公司被告知去收走芬利家的车，卫生部门也被谎报称露丝正在传播性病。

sentences.en: The most chilling correspondence was sent to a local mortuary warning them that Ruth would soon be in need of their services.
sentences.zh: 最令人不寒而栗的信件是寄给当地一家殡仪馆的，警告他们露丝很快就需要他们的服务了。

sentences.en: Detectives compared the poet's handwriting to samples from a wide range of sources but no match was found.
sentences.zh: 侦探们将“诗人”的笔迹与各种来源的样本进行了比对，但没有发现匹配项。

sentences.en: The letters underwent extensive analysis focusing on word choice, phrasing and writing patterns but these efforts also yielded no results.
sentences.zh: 信件经过了详尽的分析，重点关注用词、措辞和书写模式，但这些努力也毫无结果。

sentences.en: Chemical testing for fingerprints or saliva on the envelopes came up inconclusive.
sentences.zh: 对信封上的指纹或唾液进行的化学测试结果也不明确。

sentences.en: At one stage the police received a call from someone claiming to be
sentences.zh: 有一次，警方接到一个人的电话，自称是

sentences.en: Buddy, one of the men who had abducted
sentences.zh: 巴迪，曾绑架过

sentences.en: Ruth back in
sentences.zh: 露丝的男人之一，

sentences.en: November 1978.
sentences.zh: 时间是在1978年11月。

sentences.en: The man promised to call back but never followed through.
sentences.zh: 那人答应回电，但从未兑现。

sentences.en: Numerous hoaxes and mentally ill individuals also claimed to be the poet, further complicating the investigation.
sentences.zh: 无数恶作剧者和精神病患者也声称自己是“诗人”，这进一步使调查复杂化。

sentences.en: In early June
1980 the first letter from the poet arrived that wasn't postmarked from Wichita but from
sentences.zh: “诗人”寄来了第一封不是从威奇托，而是从

sentences.en: Oklahoma City
sentences.zh: 俄克拉荷马城

sentences.en: 160 miles to the south.
sentences.zh: 寄出的信，那里在南边160英里外。

sentences.en: Around the same time police received an anonymous tip saying that a man resembling the poet was living in a trailer west of the city having been fired from his job
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，警方收到匿名举报，称一名长相酷似“诗人”的男子住在城西的一辆拖车里，他七个月前被解雇了。
